mines.mine_notes: Open-pit gold mine within the Garden Gully Gold Project, Abbotts Greenstone Belt, ~north of Meekatharra, WA. First blast 30 June 2025; production commenced September 2025. Ore crushed and sampled on site, sold under Ore Purchase Agreement to Westgold's Big Bell Gold Operations (BBGO) and processed at the Bluebird mill. Sold 516,925 t of ore in the 9-month period, above the 450,000 t OPA maximum (both parties agreed to exceed to use available Bluebird capacity after softer Crown Prince oxide ore was introduced). Revenue concentrated with a single customer. Stage 2 pit progression; Crown Prince underground (150,400 oz MRE) is a growth target with PFS planned. [production_notes: 9-month period to 30 Jun 2026: 54,952 attributable ounces sold after agreed recoveries (ore sold to Westgold, not bullion). Dec 2025 quarter (first full quarter): 184,746 dry tonnes at agreed grade 4.0 g/t Au and 95.9% recovery = 22,766 oz delivered.] [primary_commodity: Gold] [cost_breakdown_notes: Attributable AISC A$2,882/oz; attributable bullion price applied under OPA A$6,531/oz (both AUD, flagged).]

mines.status: Development (mine established; first ore crushing Sep 2026)
mines.mine_notes: Second mine front ~300 m east of Crown Prince (previously known as Crown Prince East), within the approved mining proposal for M51/886. Mining commenced late June 2026; two-stage open-pit operation planned to run into Q3 CY2027 using existing Crown Prince operating and infrastructure arrangements. First caprock ore to be crushed in September 2026. Expected to add ~20,000 oz Au in ore to the production profile over the coming 12-18 months. Mining inventory 365,000 t at 1.73 g/t for 19,334 oz. [production_notes: Mining commenced late June 2026; first ore crushed Sep 2026. No production in the transitional FY.] [primary_commodity: Gold]
